test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster:

WEL: DVO :: FOR: ULI :: SDX: ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

WEL : DVO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fc4da8f91f859c22c24120b31b5277cd35cc86e88ab4863f191122edf7e1c99.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80144da290e421126c32342eeb415a8c5375ba7ec28236b6d5389be3cb064943.png] 

FOR : ULI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18d9b6239486f66fc834fa8361db85d7cd84e74a7996aa5844301dd37086f660.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5f6d2a2650247204487bdca4ed61951cbf0e95f96ecfdbd04036abbe8da90cd.png] 

Similarly, SDX : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa7762de1d8242c83f2a82ce53a5c41d5cedbf139304ab7e7c95c2f91e293afe.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/071c7c6c319ce60d553dca93bb4e4327291d4f52771b31da4bb1d3a85d33721a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "HWC".
